scenarios.published_three_blank_mean: Mean of K1, K2 and K3 at each reading, as published.
scenarios.k1_running_maximum: K1 replaced by its running maximum so cumulative methane never decreases.
scenarios.exclude_k1: Mean of K2 and K3 only.
scenarios.exclude_k2: Mean of K1 and K3 only.
scenarios.exclude_k3: Mean of K1 and K2 only.

interpretation_boundary: Sensitivity analysis only. The published three-blank correction remains the reference; no source value is repaired and no blank is removed from the dataset.
